responsibility: Declares the thunk_info symbol-table annotation and thunk expansion interface. It defines the data carried for this-adjusting and result-adjusting thunks, including fixed, virtual, and indirect offsets, wrapped target alias, streaming/dumping/hash APIs, and summary lifecycle helpers, plus the expand_thunk entry point. It is the public metadata interface for thunk support implemented in symtab-thunks.cc.
same_name_distinction: Declares the thunk_info metadata structure and public thunk interface, including fields describing adjustments and the expand_thunk entry point, while symtab-thunks.cc contains the actual storage, streaming, and expansion logic.
